content.title: 5 Insightful Analyst Questions From Schneider’s Q3 Earnings Call
content.summary: Schneider’s third quarter was marked by a strong top-line performance but significant bottom-line weakness, triggering a notable negative market reaction. Management attributed the quarter’s underwhelming profitability to an unexpected $16 million increase in claims-related costs, primarily stemming from adverse developments on prior year insurance claims. content.title: SNDR Q3 Deep Dive: Higher Claims Costs and Subdued Demand Shape Transportation Results
content.summary: Transportation company Schneider (NYSE:SNDR) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $1.45 billion. Its GAAP profit of $0.11 per share was 45.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Schneider National (SNDR): Modest Margin Gain Reinforces Debate Over Premium Valuation and Profit Outlook
content.summary: Schneider National (SNDR) posted net profit margins of 2.3%, edging up from 2.2% a year earlier, and delivered 7.3% earnings growth over the past year. Despite this uptick, the company’s five-year record points to steeper challenges, with average annual earnings falling 14.4%. Looking ahead, revenue is expected to grow at 4.9% per year, which is below the broader US market’s pace of 10.3%. See our full analysis for Schneider National.
